column1: # Claims these documents make about ANOTHER repository's standing state, and
# the artefact that settles each one. Checked by tools/docs/verify-world.sh,
# which needs the network; `make docs-verify` stays offline and does not read
# this.
# A row is: claim<TAB>kind<TAB>locator<TAB>expected<TAB>stated in
#   line        the expected literal must be a line of <repo>:<path> at main
#   no-line     it must not be
#   newest-tag  the greatest tag of <repo> matching <locator prefix>[./] must
#               match the expected ERE
#   no-path     the locator's PARENT DIRECTORY must not list its basename;
#               the expected column is the literal `absent`. The parent is
#               listed rather than the path probed because a probe answers
#               "not found" both for an absent file and for a reader that
#               never arrived, and a directory that answers proves the reach.
# ONLY STANDING CLAIMS BELONG HERE: a claim that is true of the world until it
# moves. A dated measurement is true of a moment and is not re-checked.
# Completeness is unchecked: the rows are compared against the world, and
# nothing compares the documents against this file. A standing claim about
# another repository's state gets a row when it is written; a claim about its
# behaviour cannot be a row, and is cited to the repository that owns it.
